name: Shoko
description:
A Jellyfin plugin to integrate [Jellyfin](https://jellyfin.org/docs/) with [Shoko Server](https://shokoanime.com/downloads/shoko-server/).
## Read this before installing
**This plugin requires that you have already set up and are using Shoko Server**, and that the files you intend to include in Jellyfin are **indexed** (and optionally managed) by Shoko Server. **Otherwise, the plugin won't be able to provide metadata for your files**, since there is no metadata to find for them.
overview: Manage your anime from Jellyfin using metadata from Shoko

versions.changelog:
Only compatible with **12.y.z**.

See the [release notes](https://github.com/ShokoAnime/Shokofin/releases/tag/v6.0.5-dev.39) for more info.

---

`fix`: **Hand ignored media folders back to jellyfin**:

- Left ignored media folders out of the VFS, the file and refresh events, the library monitor and the ignore rule, so Jellyfin's own scanners and monitor handle them
- Re-detected the mapping when a media folder is no longer ignored
- Ignored a mapped media folder when a `.shoko-ignore` file is added to it later

`misc`: **Correct the sync on import and live sync descriptions**:

- Said that sync on import or refresh imports the watch-state for videos from Shoko
- Said that live sync requires the events during playback setting

`fix`: **Correct the auto-refresh metadata filters**:

- Kept the anti-refresh dead zone unless it's longer than the out-of-sync range, instead of the other way around
- Refreshed out-of-sync items when updating unaired items is enabled, and only for libraries the plugin is enabled for
- Treated a refresh range of 0 days as no lower limit instead of selecting nothing

`fix`: **Anchor specials to the last visible episode**:

- Tracked the last normal episode itself when building the specials anchors, so hidden episodes no longer shift a special onto the wrong or a hidden episode

`feat`: **Place specials using where shoko places them**:

- Requested the specials placement with the Shoko episodes, which servers without it ignore
- Placed specials using the first source that places them for the "other data" specials placement, and fell back to the air date for the rest with the mixed placement
- Relabelled both specials placement options to say they use the specials placement in Shoko

`fix`: **Use the playlist ordering and specials placement settings**:

- Ordered the seasons within playlists by the playlist ordering setting, and the episodes within each season by their order
- Placed specials within playlists by the playlist specials placement setting
- Marked ordering by release date as the default playlist ordering, matching the actual default

`fix`: **Use the first season's images for the specials season**:

- Used the images of the show's first season for the "Specials" season, following the season image settings, instead of leaving it to fall back to the series images
- Removed the series images offered for the "Specials" season when a client searches for its images

Closes #117

`fix`: **Hold back file events until the linked episodes and series exist**.

Only compatible with **10.11.z**.

See the [release notes](https://github.com/ShokoAnime/Shokofin/releases/tag/v6.0.5-dev.39) for more info.

`feat`: **Add a shoko similar items provider for jellyfin 12**:

- Added a remote similar items provider for series and movies on Jellyfin 12, using the series suggestions in Shoko that point at series in the collection
- Added a probe for the series suggestions endpoint, cached as `HasSuggestionsExposed`, and hid the provider when the server doesn't have it
- Scored suggestions by their approval rating when the source has one, otherwise by their order

Only compatible with **10.11.z**.

See the [release notes](https://github.com/ShokoAnime/Shokofin/releases/tag/v6.0.5-dev.38) for more info.

`fix`: **Stop creating duplicate playlists on every reconstruction**:

- Embedded `[ShokoPlaylistGroup=<id>]` in the playlist folder name so existing playlists are found again; the display name is reset to the group title
- Removed the cleanup step that deleted every Shoko playlist before each run
- Removed legacy playlists identified only by the provider id, and extra playlists per group
- Built playlists from the top-level group instead of whichever subgroup was looked up first
- Replaced the playlist items in release order when anything was added, removed or moved
- Fixed the mixed-content check for groups with series and movies in different subgroups

Only compatible with **10.11.z**.

See the [release notes](https://github.com/ShokoAnime/Shokofin/releases/tag/v6.0.5-dev.37) for more info.

`fix`: **Read string metadata ids in the signalr metadata events**:

- Allowed `SeriesID`, `ShokoEpisodeIDs` and `ShokoSeriesIDs` to be numeric JSON strings as well as numbers

`fix`: **Accept kebab-case sources in the signalr metadata events**:

- Added `JsonProviderNameConverter`, reading enum names, kebab-case values and numbers
- Unknown sources now map to `None` and are skipped instead of failing the event
